text:
alex: Quick status — console obs sprint check. Two quick asks: 1) who is currently owning the error-analysis view rollout? 2) retention milestone timeline for trace hooks (we need to finalize 90d vs 180d by EOD Wednesday). Also blocker: ingestion schema change in events-pipeline which SRE says will affect trace-backed metrics. @maria @raj @olivia :eyes:

maria: I'm taking the dashboard ownership for the initial error-analysis view. Working on layout and queries today. Can we scope the MVP to top-5 services + aggregated error rates? Not ready to own retention decision though.

raj: I own tracing hooks. We previously planned 90d but hadn't gated on storage impact. If olivia can validate cost delta, I can proceed with 90d canary for two services.

olivia: Storage check: rough estimate shows +8% cost for 90d, +25% for 180d given current sampling. Need exact numbers from evt-pipeline once schema change lands. Blocking question: does trace ingestion switch to v2 compressing spans? @sre-team

alex: thanks. Maria — for MVP, top-5 svc + aggregated is fine. Raj — can you sketch the canary plan (services + expected qps) so I can raise to PM sponsor? Put it in the sprint ticket.

raj: plan added to ticket: services = auth, api-gateway; qps=~120 combined; canary length=48h; fallback to summary-only if we see high error inflation. snippet for canary alert:
```
alert: trace_hook_error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m
```

maria: FYI I created dashboard panels and shared a link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/err-anal/preview — needs data wiring. Tagging @data-infra for pipeline mapping.

deploy-bot: deploy completed for dashboard-frontend @ 2739123521 :white_check_mark:

olivia: I'll run a storage sim later today once schema PR is merged. ETA 18:00 PT. If sim shows <12% delta we keep 90d; else propose hybrid: 90d for hot services, 30d for others.

alex: perfect. Action items: raj add canary steps + rollback playbook (due EOD today), olivia run sim and post numbers, maria final dashboard panel wiring. I'll sync with PM after numbers come in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
